description.en: A-share trading-system assistant: market timing (bottom exhaustion + stabilization signals), sentiment & style detection (institutional vs speculative), sector & leader monitoring, position sizing, trailing/ladder stop alerts, screener, K-line charts. Read-only, no auto-execution.
description.zh: A 股交易体系助手：大盘择时（跌无可跌+企稳信号）、情绪与风格判定（机构抱团vs题材妖股）、板块监控与龙头候选、仓位体检、移动/阶梯止盈止损预警、全市场选股、K线图。仅监控建议，不做自动交易。

tools.name: stock_quote
tools.description: 查询 A 股实时行情

tools.name: stock_market_timing
tools.description: 大盘择时诊断（阶段/跌无可跌/企稳信号/建议仓位）

tools.name: stock_sentiment
tools.description: 市场情绪统计 + 风格判定（抱团 vs 妖股）

tools.name: stock_holdings
tools.description: 管理持仓（监控用，不做自动交易）
